functional_semantics.triton: loss[r] = sum_c y*(where(y>0, log y, 0) - log_p) in fp32, one scalar per row (impl_triton.py:22-34).
functional_semantics.cutile: same term with the same guard (impl_cutile.py:31-49).
functional_semantics.note: Both match impl_torch.py:5 except at y == 0, where both give 0 and the reference gives NaN; the guard is unreachable for the softmax-generated inputs (tensors.py:157-164) and the contract pins the 0*log0 = 0 convention that both share.

stages.triton: fp32 loss allocation (impl_triton.py:55) + one launch, grid (rows,) (56-75).
stages.cutile: fp32 loss allocation (impl_cutile.py:59) + one launch, grid (rows,1,1) (76-77).
stages.note: One program per row, fused map + reduce on both sides.

dependencies.triton: kernel depends only on the output buffer.
dependencies.cutile: kernel depends only on the output buffer.

reduction_scan_sort.triton: sequential column chunks into a lane-wise fp32 accumulator, one tl.sum at the end (impl_triton.py:21-33).
reduction_scan_sort.cutile: sequential column tiles into a (1,TILE) fp32 accumulator, one ct.sum at the end (impl_cutile.py:28-48).
reduction_scan_sort.note: Same lane-partial-then-tree structure; config.verify atol/rtol 1e-4 absorbs ordering.

precision.triton: explicit .to(tl.float32) on both loads, fp32 accumulator, fp32 output (impl_triton.py:21,25-26,55).
precision.cutile: explicit ct.astype float32, fp32 accumulator, fp32 output (impl_cutile.py:28,41-42,59).
precision.note: fp32 throughout on both sides; the sweep is fp32-only.

preprocessing.triton: shape read + loss allocation only (impl_triton.py:54-56); row stride passed (60,68).
preprocessing.note: No casts, copies or caches on either side.

mutation.triton: inputs never written; fresh loss per call.
mutation.cutile: inputs never written; fresh loss per call.

hardware_dispatch.note: Masked loads with other=0.0 (impl_triton.py:25-26,31) vs zero-padded loads (impl_cutile.py:32-39) are mapping choices; both make tails contribute 0.

fq_boundary.note: Two fp32 inputs read once each plus the fp32 row vector written once, with 4-byte elements hard-coded (correct for the fp32-only case grid; would be wrong if a dtype axis were added). Matches the single streaming kernel on both sides; the allocation is inside run() and timed; nothing cached or prepacked.
